mapper.select:
SELECT h.device_id AS deviceId, h.identifier AS identifier, FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(h.reported_at) / #{bucketSeconds}) * #{bucketSeconds}) AS time, COUNT(*) AS sampleCount,
MIN(CAST(h.value_text AS DECIMAL(30,10))) AS minValue, MAX(CAST(h.value_text AS DECIMAL(30,10))) AS maxValue, AVG(CAST(h.value_text AS DECIMAL(30,10))) AS avgValue
NULL AS minValue, NULL AS maxValue, NULL AS avgValue
FROM device_property_history h WHERE h.reported_at >= #{startTime} AND h.reported_at < #{endTime} AND h.device_id IN #{id} AND h.identifier IN #{it} GROUP BY h.device_id, h.identifier, time ORDER BY h.device_id ASC, h.identifier ASC, time ASC
